# An agent with no account, no API key and no checkout page.
# Ask what the resource costs before deciding to call it.
curl https://api-testnet.mayarin.xyz/x402/resources/fx-quote/payment-required

# Or just call it. The gate answers with its own terms.
curl -i https://api-testnet.mayarin.xyz/premium/fx-quote
# HTTP/1.1 402 Payment Required
# PAYMENT-REQUIRED: <price, chains, assets, deadline>

# Sign one EIP-3009 authorization for exactly that amount, then ask again.
curl -i https://api-testnet.mayarin.xyz/premium/fx-quote \
  -H "PAYMENT-SIGNATURE: $AUTHORIZATION"
# HTTP/1.1 200 OK
# PAYMENT-RESPONSE: <authorization hash>

# The agent held EURC and the merchant is paid USDC. Two chain movements,
# two hashes — the swap is what settles, and the payer's change is a
# ledger liability, not a lost coin.
